title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ICSP Programme, implemented by Trócaire, contributes to outcome 6.1 Trócaire fulfils its commitment to localisation while inspiring sectoral transformation in solidarity with local actors. The objective is to provide more tailored and responsive capacity strengthening to local and national partners. Key activities include developing a CHS toolkit for CHS accreditation for local and national organisations; documenting learning; and supporting partners to develop and roll out critical accountability policies and practices ---- The principal focus of this outcome is:Partnership and localisation; with a focus on Women Centred OrganisationsProviding institutional capacity building and support to local and national partners in Rwanda
